question: Which of the following countries hosts the first para Asiad?
solution:
The correct answer is __**China**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **first Para Asian Games (Para Asiad)** were hosted by **China** in **2010**, in the city of Guangzhou, immediately following the 16th Asian Games.
 
• The motto for the Guangzhou 2010 Para Games was **“We Cheer, We Share, We Win”**, emphasizing unity, inclusion, and celebration of athletic achievements.
 
• It featured **19 sports** and **473 events**, including wheelchair basketball, table tennis, athletics, and swimming.
 
• The official mascot was **"Fun Fun"**, a smiling goat symbolizing Guangzhou's rich cultural heritage and friendliness.
 
• Athletes from **41 Asian countries and regions** competed, making it a milestone for para-sports in Asia.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Asian Para Games**

 
 
• **​**The** Asian Para Games **are a multi-sport event held every four years for athletes with physical disabilities from across Asia.
 
• They are organized by the **Asian Paralympic Committee (APC) **and are parallel to the Asian Games, specifically designed to promote inclusivity in sports
 
• The Asian Para Games were established after the **Far East and South Pacific Games for the Disabled (FESPIC Games) ended in 2006.**
 
• **Editions**:
 
 
• **2010 (Guangzhou, China)**: The inaugural edition with over 2,500 athletes from 41 countries.
 
• **2014 (Incheon, South Korea)**: Continued success with high participation and improved facilities.
 
• **2018 (Jakarta, Indonesia)**: Marked further growth with a record number of events and athletes.
 
• **2023 (Hangzhou, China)**: Focused on innovation and inclusivity, featuring advanced technology for accessibility.
